import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Только позиции заказов, совершённых до seed_time
    items_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] <= seed_time].copy()
    items_hist["total_value"] = items_hist["price"] + items_hist["freight_value"]

    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    # Временные окна агрегации по позициям
    windows = {"7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90, "365d": 365, "all_time": None}
    for window_name, days in windows.items():
        if days is None:
            window_data = items_hist
        else:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            window_data = items_hist[items_hist["ts"] >= cutoff]

        if len(window_data) == 0:
            continue

        agg_params = {
            "order_id": ["count", "nunique"],
            "price": ["mean", "sum", "min", "max"],
            "freight_value": ["mean", "sum"],
            "total_value": ["mean", "sum"],
            "seller_id": "nunique",
            "order_item_id": "max",
        }
        window_agg = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_params)
        window_agg.columns = [f"{window_name}_{c1}_{c2}" for c1, c2 in window_agg.columns]
        base = base.join(window_agg, how="left")

    # Временные характеристики истории продаж (по моменту покупки)
    if len(items_hist) > 0:
        time_metrics = items_hist.groupby("product_id")["ts"].agg(["min", "max"])
        time_metrics["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - time_metrics["min"]).dt.days
        time_metrics["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - time_metrics["max"]).dt.days
        time_metrics["sales_span_days"] = (
            (time_metrics["max"] - time_metrics["min"]).dt.days
        )
        base = base.join(
            time_metrics[["days_since_first_purchase", "days_since_last_purchase", "sales_span_days"]],
            how="left",
        )

    # Признаки по отзывам: учитываем только отзывы, созданные до seed_time
    rev_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    if len(items_hist) > 0 and len(rev_hist) > 0:
        product_reviews = (
            items_hist[["product_id", "order_id"]]
            .drop_duplicates()
            .merge(rev_hist[["order_id", "review_score"]], on="order_id", how="inner")
        )
        if len(product_reviews) > 0:
            grp = product_reviews.groupby("product_id")["review_score"]
            review_agg = grp.agg(["count", "mean", "min", "max", "std"])
            review_agg["five_star_ratio"] = (
                (product_reviews["review_score"] == 5).astype(float)
            ).groupby(product_reviews["product_id"]).mean()
            review_agg["one_star_ratio"] = (
                (product_reviews["review_score"] == 1).astype(float)
            ).groupby(product_reviews["product_id"]).mean()
            review_agg.columns = [f"review_{c}" for c in review_agg.columns]
            base = base.join(review_agg, how="left")

    # Признаки по платежам: только платежи, существующие на момент seed_time
    pay_hist = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]
    if len(items_hist) > 0 and len(pay_hist) > 0:
        product_payments = (
            items_hist[["product_id", "order_id"]]
            .drop_duplicates()
            .merge(pay_hist, on="order_id", how="inner")
        )
        if len(product_payments) > 0:
            grp = product_payments.groupby("product_id")
            pay_agg = grp.agg(
                payment_count=("payment_value", "count"),
                payment_avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
                payment_max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
                payment_avg_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
                payment_total_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
            )
            credit_ratio = (
                (product_payments["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(float)
            ).groupby(product_payments["product_id"]).mean()
            pay_agg["payment_credit_ratio"] = credit_ratio
            base = base.join(pay_agg, how="left")

    # Доля дней в последних 90, когда товар продавался (регулярность спроса)
    if len(items_hist) > 0:
        cutoff90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        recent = items_hist[items_hist["ts"] >= cutoff90]
        if len(recent) > 0:
            active_days = recent.assign(day=recent["ts"].dt.floor("D")).groupby("product_id")["day"].nunique()
            active_days.name = "active_days_90d"
            base = base.join(active_days, how="left")
            base["active_days_ratio_90d"] = base["active_days_90d"] / 90.0

    # Пропуски: отсутствие истории = 0; отсутствие даты первой покупки кодируем большим числом
    if "days_since_first_purchase" in base.columns:
        base["days_since_first_purchase"] = base["days_since_first_purchase"].fillna(10_000)
        base["days_since_last_purchase"] = base["days_since_last_purchase"].fillna(10_000)
        base["sales_span_days"] = base["sales_span_days"].fillna(0)
    if "active_days_90d" in base.columns:
        base["active_days_90d"] = base["active_days_90d"].fillna(0)
        base["active_days_ratio_90d"] = base["active_days_ratio_90d"].fillna(0)

    base = base.fillna(0)
    base = base.loc[:, ~base.columns.duplicated()]
    base = base.reindex(entity_ids)

    # Гарантия полностью числовых столбцов
    for c in base.columns:
        base[c] = pd.to_numeric(base[c], errors="coerce")
    base = base.fillna(0).astype(float)

    return base
